Customs Act 1969: This Act provides the legal authority under Section 19(1) for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to grant customs duty concessions.
First Schedule: The goods covered under this SRO are identified within the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.
National Board of Revenue: The government consults with this body when exercising its powers to grant import duty concessions under the Customs Act.
Preferential Trade Agreement Among D-8 M: This agreement serves as the foundational legal basis for granting preferential tariff treatment to specific goods imported from D-8 member countries.
TABLE: This table specifies the H.S. Code, product description, and the applicable duty concession rates for goods originating from designated D-8 member countries.
